mapper.select: SELECT STUDY_ID AS studyId, LEADER_ID AS leaderId, TITLE AS title, CONTENT AS content, MAX_MEMBER AS maxMember, CURRENT_MEMBER AS currentMember, STATUS AS status, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, REG_DATE AS regDate, CANCEL_REASON AS cancelReason, CANCEL_DATE AS cancelDate FROM TB_STUDY WHERE STATUS <> 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STUDY ( STUDY_ID, LEADER_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, MAX_MEMBER, CURRENT_MEMBER, STATUS, START_DATE, END_DATE, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_STUDY.NEXTVAL, #{leaderId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{maxMember}, 1, 'OPEN', #{startDate}, #{endDate}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT STUDY_ID AS studyId, LEADER_ID AS leaderId, TITLE AS title, CONTENT AS content, MAX_MEMBER AS maxMember, CURRENT_MEMBER AS currentMember, STATUS AS status, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, REG_DATE AS regDate, CANCEL_REASON AS cancelReason, CANCEL_DATE AS cancelDate FROM TB_STUDY WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STUDY SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, MAX_MEMBER = #{maxMember}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, END_DATE = #{endDate} WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId}
UPDATE TB_STUDY SET STATUS = 'CLOSED' WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND STATUS = 'OPEN'
UPDATE TB_STUDY SET STATUS = 'OPEN' WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND STATUS = 'CLOSED' AND CURRENT_MEMBER < MAX_MEMBER
UPDATE TB_STUDY SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED', CANCEL_REASON = #{cancelReason}, CANCEL_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND STATUS <> 'CANCELLED'
UPDATE TB_STUDY_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED' WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND STATUS <> 'CANCELLED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STUDY_MEMBER ( STUDY_MEMBER_ID, STUDY_ID, MEMBER_ID, STATUS, APPLY_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_STUDY_MEMBER.NEXTVAL, #{studyId}, #{memberId}, 'WAIT', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT STUDY_MEMBER_ID AS studyMemberId, STUDY_ID AS studyId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, STATUS AS status, APPLY_DATE AS applyDate FROM TB_STUDY_MEMBER WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId} ORDER BY APPLY_DATE ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STUDY_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'APPROVED' WHERE STUDY_MEMBER_ID = #{studyMemberId} AND STATUS = 'WAIT'
UPDATE TB_STUDY_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'REJECTED' WHERE STUDY_MEMBER_ID = #{studyMemberId} AND STATUS = 'WAIT'
UPDATE TB_STUDY SET CURRENT_MEMBER = CURRENT_MEMBER + 1 WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND CURRENT_MEMBER < MAX_MEMBER
UPDATE TB_STUDY SET STATUS = 'CLOSED' WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND CURRENT_MEMBER >= MAX_MEMBER AND STATUS = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT STUDY_MEMBER_ID AS studyMemberId, STUDY_ID AS studyId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, STATUS AS status, APPLY_DATE AS applyDate FROM TB_STUDY_MEMBER WHERE STUDY_MEMBER_ID = #{studyMemberId}

SELECT STUDY_MEMBER_ID AS studyMemberId, STUDY_ID AS studyId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, STATUS AS status, APPLY_DATE AS applyDate FROM TB_STUDY_MEMBER WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STUDY_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'WAIT', APPLY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS IN ('REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')
UPDATE TB_STUDY_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED' WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'WAIT'
UPDATE TB_STUDY SET CURRENT_MEMBER = CURRENT_MEMBER - 1 WHERE STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND CURRENT_MEMBER > 1
